nodes.Name: dataDivSrc
nodes.ValueLiteral:

       PROGRAM-ID. DATATEST.

       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 WS-CUSTOMER-RECORD.
          05 WS-CUST-ID      PIC 9(6).
          05 WS-CUST-NAME    PIC X(40).
          05 WS-CUST-BALANCE PIC S9(9)V99.
       01 WS-COUNTER         PIC 9(4) VALUE ZEROS.

       PROCEDURE DIVISION.

`

nodes.Name: procedureSrc
nodes.ValueLiteral:
`
       IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. PROCTEST.

       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 WS-FLAG PIC X VALUE 'N'.

       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       MAIN-SECTION SECTION.
       MAIN-PARA.
           PERFORM VALIDATE-PARA
           IF WS-FLAG = 'Y'
               PERFORM PROCESS-PARA
           END-IF
           STOP RUN.
       VALIDATE-PARA.
           MOVE 'Y' TO WS-FLAG.
       PROCESS-PARA.
           DISPLAY 'Processing'.
`

nodes.Name: cicsSrc
nodes.ValueLiteral:
`
       IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. CICSTEST.

       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 WS-DATA PIC X(100).

       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       MAIN-LOGIC.
           EXEC CICS READ
               FILE('CUSTOMER')
               INTO(WS-DATA)
               RIDFLD(WS-CUST-ID)
               RESP(WS-RESP)
           END-EXEC
           EXEC CICS WRITEQ TS
               QUEUE('MYQUEUE')
               FROM(WS-DATA)
           END-EXEC
           EXEC CICS RETURN
           END-EXEC.
`

           CALL 'ERRHANDLR'.
           STOP RUN.
`

nodes.Name: TestCOBOL_InlinePerformUntilBodyNests_v24
nodes.DocComment:
v24 — inline PERFORM UNTIL … END-PERFORM must nest the statements between the
header and END-PERFORM as the loop BODY (previously the body was lost and the
statements attached at the wrong scope level).
